title: KTAG developer
text: I’ve been given the opportunity to develop several systems for Kolej Tan Sri Aisyah Ghani (KTAG) UPM, including the DapurSiswa Management System and a booking system. It has been a genuine pleasure to work alongside a group of young, visionary students who are passionate about bringing their ideas to life through technology. I’m grateful for the trust they’ve placed in me and excited to contribute to making their vision a reality.
